title: DiracX Tasks
description: Task system of DiracX: throughput, queues, workers and scheduler (OpenTelemetry metrics)

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Tasks completed successfully per second.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Task executions which raised an exception, per second.

panels.title: Failure ratio
panels.description: Failed executions over all the executions.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(tasks_failed_total{service_name=~"$service", task_name=~"$task_name"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(rate(tasks_failed_total{service_name=~"$service", task_name=~"$task_name"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(tasks_completed_total{service_name=~"$service", task_name=~"$task_name"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Backlog
panels.description: Tasks in the streams not picked up by any worker yet (requires Redis >= 7).

panels.title: In progress
panels.description: Tasks delivered to a worker and not acknowledged yet.

panels.title: Delayed
panels.description: Tasks waiting for their time in the delayed ZSET (scheduled tasks and retries).

panels.title: Worker utilisation
panels.description: Tasks running over the total worker capacity (max concurrent tasks).

panels.title: Scheduler
panels.description: Number of scheduler instances holding the singleton lock: it must be exactly 1.

panels.title: Submitted vs processed
panels.description: Tasks submitted (by the API, the scheduler and other tasks) against tasks executed. A sustained gap means the workers do not keep up.

panels.title: Completed by task
panels.description: Tasks completed per second (8 most frequent).

panels.title: Failed by task
panels.description: Task executions which raised an exception. The traceback is attached to the task.execute span.

panels.title: Execution time p95 by task
panels.description: 95th percentile of the execution time (8 slowest tasks).

panels.title: Queue wait p95 by priority
panels.description: Time between a task entering its stream and a worker picking it up. realtime tasks should barely wait; growing waits mean more workers are needed.

panels.title: Backlog by stream
panels.description: Tasks not delivered to any worker yet, per stream (empty streams are hidden).

panels.title: In progress by stream
panels.description: Tasks delivered to a worker but not acknowledged yet, per stream.

panels.title: Reclaimed messages
panels.description: Messages taken over from a worker which did not acknowledge them in time: usually a crashed or killed worker.

panels.title: Delayed tasks waiting
panels.description: Tasks in the delayed ZSET (scheduled for later, or waiting for a retry).

panels.title: Delayed tasks promoted
panels.description: Delayed tasks moved to their stream by the scheduler.

panels.title: Utilisation by worker size
panels.description: Running tasks over the capacity of the workers of each size. At 100%, tasks queue up.

targets.expr: sum by (size) (tasks_in_progress{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance"}) / on (size) label_replace(sum by (worker_size) (worker_max_concurrent_tasks{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance"}), "size", "$1", "worker_size", "(.*)")

panels.title: Utilisation by worker
panels.description: Running tasks over the capacity of each worker.

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (tasks_in_progress{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance"}) / sum by (service_instance_id) (worker_max_concurrent_tasks{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Running tasks by task
panels.description: Tasks being executed right now (8 largest).

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Tasks rescheduled after an error, or because a lock or limiter could not be acquired (lock_contention).

panels.title: Given up
panels.description: Tasks which exhausted their retries: dlq = persisted in the dead letter queue, discarded = not dlq-eligible, dlq_failed = could not be persisted (lost).

panels.title: Rejected messages
panels.description: Messages dropped by the workers: unparsable, or for a task which is not installed (unknown_task).

panels.title: Periodic submissions
panels.description: Periodic tasks submitted by the scheduler.

panels.title: Scheduler instances
panels.description: 1 for the scheduler instance holding the lock, 0 for standby instances.

panels.title: Query latency p95 by database
panels.description: 95th percentile of the SQL query duration, per database.

panels.title: Queries by database and operation
panels.description: SQL queries per second (8 busiest database/operation pairs).

panels.title: Query errors
panels.description: SQL queries which raised an exception, per database and exception type.

panels.title: Connection pool usage (busiest instance)
panels.description: Connections checked out of the SQLAlchemy pool over the pool capacity (pool_size + max_overflow), for the instance with the fullest pool. At 100%, requests wait for a connection.

targets.expr: max by (db_client_connection_pool_name) (db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", diracx_component=~"tasks-.*", db_client_connection_state="used"} / ignoring (db_client_connection_state) db_client_connection_max{service_name=~"$service", diracx_component=~"tasks-.*"})

panels.title: Connection wait p95 by database
panels.description: Time spent waiting for a connection of the pool (95th percentile). It should stay far below the query latency: if not, the pool is too small for the load.

panels.title: Connection timeouts
panels.description: Requests or tasks which failed because no connection of the pool was available before pool_timeout.

panels.title: Connections in use by instance
panels.description: Connections currently checked out of the pools, per instance.
